_comment: Product-owner adjudications of RUBRIC.md section 2.2 — an ambiguity v1 section 2 does not
cover, applied at gold assembly only.
WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO. It does not edit a raw label: the owner's answers stand exactly as
made, the pilot's PRIMARY and SENSITIVITY readings stand exactly as published, and the
overlap agreement in agreement.json is computed from raw answers before anything here is
applied. This file changes one thing: the tier that reaches labels.json for these reviews.
THE ORDERING IS STATED BECAUSE IT MATTERS. The ambiguity surfaced while reading the pilot,
where these two rows were the only ones a model arm missed. A rule clarified after seeing
which rows a candidate got wrong is the exact move this contract exists to prevent, so what
protects it is written down rather than assumed: the raw labels are untouched, the pilot
numbers are not restated, the clarification lowers a tier rather than raising one (it can
only REDUCE the positive class every candidate is scored against), and for the 220-row gold
set it is a genuine pre-commitment — the annotator had labeled nothing when it was made.
reasonCode is left as the owner wrote it. TEXTLESS_OR_NOISE beside WATCH no longer crosses
section 3.1's actionable column, which is what made the pairing a finding in the first place.
